(Ad = eight minutes to speed up; 1600!!! coins = 25 minutes.) It feels like they figured if I paid for ad-free, I’d be willing to spend even more to buy coins for a very basic feature. Without the speed-up function — something they heavily touted in the first few levels — the game is extremely slow and boring, especially when there’s only one ant out at a time moseying up to the top of the puzzle to grab one block, deliver it to the bottom, then walk slowly back up to the top for the next one. Thinking it was a fluke, I gave it a few more levels, but the wall is still there. No way to email the developer, and Apple twice refused to give me my money back even though this was a clear violation. (Not the first time this has happened.)

I was on level 788, updated the game, and now I’m on level 1. I see there is a Save Progress option. I can’t say for sure if this existed in earlier versions of the game. title: This isn’t a game, it’s a slot machine.
body: This isn’t a strategy game or puzzle game. A strategy game implies that you have the information you need to beat the game and the challenge comes from finding the correct options and making the right decisions. This game intentionally obfuscates necessary information, which forces you to either fail the level, use powerups, or go look up information on external websites. There will be times in the game where you need to hit a specific color, and you will have no idea which of the 4 “slots” that color will show up in first, because the game hides that if info. You then have to guess randomly and either accept the loss if you don’t get lucky and hit the 1/4 on your first try, or you have to use a power up. Accepting a loss wouldn’t be bad if not for the fact that this game uses a ln energy system, so if you get bad luck too many times or just play for a bit at once, you’ll run out of lives through zero fault if your own. Genuinely a trash game, a moderately fun concept that was intentionally kneecapped and turned into to a totally random guessing game for the sole purpose of making it REQUIRED to use micro transactions to keep playing, either to use powerups or to re-up your lives

title: No interest in maintaining a long term user base
body: The game is actually pretty addicting and can be a bit challenging at times. Unfortunately, it’s nothing more than a way for the developer to maximize their income. In addition to the IAP store, you can watch ads for an occasional bonus. That’s all fine and good. I have a problem with the sneaky design and forced ads: you are forced to watch a lengthy ad after nearly every level played. The game features unnecessarily long animations after any action which prevent user interaction. This is a blatantly obvious attempt to mask the number of ads shown by feigning gameplay. This game is basically an ad player with an occasional 30-second break for actual gameplay. This kind of behavior in apps is common, but should not be supported. There are legitimate ways of making money from free apps while keeping the experience of the user favorable.

title: Overly Expensive

Why does it cost 900 coins to revive when you get stuck, but you only earn 20 coins after completing a level? That’s a huge difference, and it makes it almost impossible to save up enough coins to use the features that are supposed to help us. I genuinely enjoy playing this game, and I want to keep enjoying it, but the excessive ads and unbalanced coin system make that difficult. Please consider reducing the frequency of ads and making the cost of revives and other assistance more reasonable. I’m sure I’m not the only player who feels this way. title: Genuine Review!
body: I’ve been playing this game for about 2 hours and haven’t seen a single ad. However, I’m seeing other reviews that say there are ads in the middle of levels… I havent encountered any mid-level ads so far. In fact, I haven’t encountered ANY ads! Im sure once you run out of the little power ups/cheats you can watch an ad to get more, but I’ve been playing for 2 hours and have only actually used 1 power up. I’m not sure if the reveiws that says there are ads are accurate or not-its possible I haven’t been playing this game long enough, maybe there are more ads later on. But I’m not sure. Anyway, I love the game overall, it’s really fun and decently easy but not too easy once you get to a higher level. Obviously it starts out really easy. I love watching the ants go back and forth, it’s actually adorable 😁 makes me like ants more. And the way they carry the blocks over their heads is so cute. I want an ant farm now… Overall, great game so far! I’m yet to see any ads at all so I’m not sure if those other reviews about a lot of ads are true or not because I haven’t been playing for too long. But this is definitely a fun little minigame to play for when you’re bored!
